goal: Automatically process new Acme cases by updating the contact name, escalating the status, and creating a follow-up Call task assigned to Shrey Sharma with a comment.
summary: This plan automates the daily triage of new cases for the Acme account. It navigates to the Acme Cases list view and drains it: for each case it extracts the contact name, sets the Contact Name field, escalates Status to Escalated, then creates a Call task with every field filled explicitly (Subject, Assigned To = Shrey Sharma, Due Date, Comments, Status) and saves it. Task creation is broken into one step per field so no field is silently skipped and the Assigned To lookup is never left on its default owner. Every state-changing step carries a success_condition so it self-skips if the target state is already present, making each iteration idempotent for any partial-completion state.

decision_rules.rule: Only process cases that have a status of 'New' in the Acme Cases list view.
decision_rules.inferred_from: Narration: 'Once I click on that and if I see any new cases with a status as new, that's a case which I'm supposed to work on.'

decision_rules.rule: Each processing step self-skips if its target state is already present, making the plan idempotent for any partial-completion state.
decision_rules.inferred_from: Per-step success_conditions checked before acting; the drain loop's backstop pauses if the same record is served twice.

decision_rules.rule: The follow-up task must be assigned to Shrey Sharma, not the default record owner, and must include the Comments note.
decision_rules.inferred_from: Prior run created the task but left it assigned to Sumit Paliwal and skipped the Comments field; task creation is now one explicit step per field.

correction_history: Replaced coarse has_Call_task extract+decision with per-step success_conditions for full idempotency across all partial states. Merged New Task click + form fill into one create_task step. Added drain backstop for stuck-loop detection.

Expanded the single create_task step into explicit per-field steps (New Task click, Subject, Assigned To, Due Date, Comments, Status, Save, Verify) because the collapsed step left Assigned To on its default owner (Sumit Paliwal), skipped Comments, and did not reliably save. Each field now has its own success_condition.
